services.name: Surf Camps
services.desc: Everyday California is proud to be a part of the local surfing culture and offers rental surfboards and boogie boards for anybody looking to have fun in the waves. The surf in the La Jolla Shores area is great for beginners, so you don’t have to be a professional surfer to have a great time out in the water! Please note that we give a safety briefing to each renter, but we do not provide surf lessons for rentals. If you're new to surfing and would like to learn how, we recommend you check out our surf lessons first. services.name: Kayak Rental
services.desc: One of our experienced Everyday California tour guides will take you on an unforgettable tour of La Jolla Ecological Reserve, a Marine Protected Area that’s home to a thriving underwater ecosystem that boasts one of the highest concentrations of sea-life in all of California! Kayak through the underwater park to experience the La Jolla Sea Caves, one of San Diego’s hidden gems and coolest attractions. Seasons change, but we’re always running: throughout the summer months you’ll have a chance to see one of the biggest Leopard Shark gatherings in the world, and in the winter witness Gray Whales on their annual migration from Alaska to Baja California. services.name: Snorkel Rental
services.desc: Everyday California’s snorkel gear rentals allow you to explore La Jolla’s vibrant coastline and diverse marine life on your own. We have masks and snorkels for adults and kids, as well as a wide array of fins to fit almost everyone (We do not have prescription snorkel masks). There is plenty of rental gear if you’re looking to take a large group on the water. Please note that we give a safety briefing to each renter, but we do not provide snorkel lessons for rentals. If you're new to snorkeling and would like to learn how, we recommend you check out our tours first. This option comes with everything you need: mask, snorkel, and fins for the day. You can add a wetsuit to the package as well

services.name: Whale Watching Tour
services.desc: Grey Whales begin their annual migration from the coast of Alaska in October, bringing them past the beautiful shores of La Jolla, San Diego from the end of November until the beginning of March. Join us for a chance to have an incredibly intimate experience with some of the most majestic mammals on the planet! Experience the grey whale migration from the seat of a kayak! Leaving the waters of the Arctic and heading south to the lagoons of Mexico, gray whales naturally migrate past San Diego during the winter. services.name: SUP Board Lessons
services.desc: Stand-up Paddle Boarding is one of the best ways to get out and enjoy the water. The sport began as an ancient Hawaiian tradition that was reintroduced to the world in the mid-60’s and has since become the fastest growing board spot in the world, largely credited to the fact that it’s pretty easy to learn!
